name: blueprint/gh-flow
description: The issue-to-merge path as receipts: gh CLI steps through rh_run, one receipt per step, guard ask on push, the pre-commit gate reviews the diff
ingredients: rh_run gh (auth in the user's local gh config)
guard ask on the push step
recipe: open the issue and branch -> commit (gate receipts from pre-commit-gate) -> push behind the guard -> open the PR, review the diff, merge with a receipt
pitfalls: gh auth is the user's local config - nothing keyed enters the plugin
receipts per step make a failed flow auditable
the gate reviews the DIFF, not the run output
